name: Shiv Mandir
town_description: Changlang is the headquarters of Changlang district in southeastern Arunachal Pradesh, near the Myanmar border and not far from where the morning sun first touches India. It is an administrative hub for the Tangsa, Tutsa, and other tribal communities; the indigenous Rangfraa faith is prominent here alongside Hindu and Buddhist shrines.

travel.airport: Nearest commercial airport is Dibrugarh (Assam); onward by road via Margherita/Ledo (verify locally)
travel.railway: No railway in the district; nearest railheads in Assam (verify locally)
travel.road: Connected by road from Tinsukia/Margherita side via NH 315 corridor; mountain roads, allow a full day from the plains
